conf.description: Cisco ESA mail-logs, format other (qmail Format Mail Logs): routing/tagging only, per recommendations.direct.cribl - no field extraction. The work order's own fields[] array is empty; Cisco does not publish the qmail-specific per-tag layout or tai64n record shape anywhere in the accessible AsyncOS logging chapter, and the direct-route recommendation itself states this 'collapses to use the Text Mail Logs instead' with no guard forcing qmail's text-inspectability.

conf.comment: cisco-esa/mail-logs/other (qmail Format Mail Logs). fields[] is empty in this work order - Cisco documents the DELIVERY-LOG statistics set this feed carries but not the qmail-specific per-tag layout or tai64n-stamped record shape that would let a pipeline extract named fields; recommendations.direct.cribl says a real sample off a live appliance subscription is required to recover it, and that with no guard the recommendation 'collapses to use the Text Mail Logs instead.' Per the brief's rule against guessing field names/tag layouts, no extraction is attempted here - inventing a tag regex would silently mis-map every record. This pipeline only tags event.dataset. Use the Text Mail Logs (syslog-cef/syslog-raw) pipelines for this dataset's actual parsed delivery data.
